settings.title: Made in Kashmir

settings.a: Kashmir's own craft soda — bold flavour, bold fizz, made in Kashmir. Three flavours, 300 ml slim cans, caffeine-free. Bootstrapped and built in the valley by a local founder.

Green Apple — crisp and loud. Mojito — cool and cheeky (non-alcoholic). Watermelon — big and bold. Green Apple for the picnic, Mojito for the houseboat, Watermelon for the drive. Can't pick? Build a box with all three.
Yes — all three flavours are caffeine-free. Order it morning, noon, or late on the shikara. The only buzz here is the fizz.
Nope. Our Mojito is non-alcoholic — all the cool, cheeky mint-and-lime fun, zero alcohol.

We ship across India — whether you're in Srinagar or sending a box to family three states away. Tourists: order before you leave and take Kashmir home. Made in small batches in Kashmir, packed and posted with care.

Two ways to buy: a 12-can box of a single flavour at ₹600, or Build-Your-Own at ₹660 — mix Green Apple, Mojito and Watermelon across 12 cans, or tap 'All 3, evenly' or 'Surprise me'. Ships across India.
